title: Social Class Adventure
welcome_lead: What is social class, and does it still matter? 🎩
meta_desc: Class & Poverty Adventure 1 — KS3 Sociology on social class and its meaning today.
final_note: You learned what social class means and the main UK classes.

concepts.def: Group based on income and job

walkthroughs.body_html:
Social class is a group sharing income, job and lifestyle.

It's not just about cash — it's accent, education, area too.

• Working class — manual or service work, lower pay.
  • Middle class — office or professional jobs.
  • Upper class — wealthy, often inherited.

The ONS uses 8 official categories — reality is messier than 3 boxes.

Income = money flowing in each year.

Wealth = total value of stuff owned (houses, savings).

The richest 1% in the UK own more than the bottom 50% combined. 📉
